items.q: Do we really have to wait a year before using the water?
items.a: No. WHO TRS 1033 allows use from phase 2 when data show the required quality and your quality unit approves. The year covers seasonal feed water changes.

items.q: Can IQ and OQ be combined into one protocol?
items.a: Yes, where complexity allows (Annex 15, 2.5). On a packaged PW skid it saves a review cycle; on a full system we keep them apart.

items.q: We work to ASTM E2500, not IQ/OQ/PQ. Can you?
items.a: Yes. The tests are much the same; verification focuses on critical aspects from the risk assessment. We write the C&Q plan in your model.

items.q: What if an action level is exceeded during PQ?
items.a: It is a deviation under your procedure. We investigate with you, verify the fix by resampling, and the phase may be extended.

items.q: Can you qualify a system you did not build?
items.a: Yes. We start with a gap assessment of the qualification file and the installed system, then propose a scope your quality unit approves.
